messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Turning on data roaming will not delete or affect any photos, contacts, or other data on your phone. It simply allows your phone to use data networks while you're outside your home coverage area. Your files and apps remain completely safe.

Please use `toggle_roaming()` to turn data roaming ON. After you do this, let me know when it's done.

Once data roaming is ON, we'll continue with the next steps to get your MMS working.

I just checked, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. I'm a bit frustrated as this has been going on for hours. Can you please help me fix this quickly? What should be the next step?

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
